Latest block is basically entirely full it only took 18 minutes to produce it... better be full 😂 lol FWIW for folks, I just broadcast a type 2 transaction that got mined: https://ropsten.etherscan.io/tx/0xa90fbe51eaf565b0040302c0fc13403bd912e02eb95deb427f5b0c0b0232cd33 based on geth release notes, miners that had set --miner.gaslimit intentionally (which i assume is almost all for it to be so high), it is odd that the default value itself didn't double for 1559 - is this something that would be done for 1.10.5 as we get closer or maybe never/after fork? release notes: ``` To ensure that the gas available for transactions is the same as before the fork, the gas limit is doubled at the fork block. If you are using the --miner.gaslimit flag to participate in voting, you need to double the value of this flag to keep voting for the same value as before. Example: You are using --miner.gaslimit to vote for a limit of 20M, and the actual block gas limit is 20M. When London activates, the block gas limit will adjust to 40M, but you will still be voting it down towards to 20M if you keep using the same --miner.gaslimit setting. So at some point after the fork, you need to double your --miner.gaslimit value to ensure the gas limit stays at 40M gas. ``` default config (last changed in 2019): https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/master/eth/ethconfig/config.go#L82-L83 Yup, that's it. excerpts.author: Deleted User
excerpts.content:
based on geth release notes, miners that had set --miner.gaslimit intentionally (which i assume is almost all for it to be so high), it is odd that the default value itself didn't double for 1559 - is this something that would be done for 1.10.5 as we get closer or maybe never/after fork? 
release notes: 
```
To ensure that the gas available for transactions is the same as before the fork, the gas limit is doubled at the fork block. If you are using the --miner.gaslimit flag to participate in voting, you need to double the value of this flag to keep voting for the same value as before.

Example: You are using --miner.gaslimit to vote for a limit of 20M, and the actual block gas limit is 20M. When London activates, the block gas limit will adjust to 40M, but you will still be voting it down towards to 20M if you keep using the same --miner.gaslimit setting. So at some point after the fork, you need to double your --miner.gaslimit value to ensure the gas limit stays at 40M gas.
```

default config (last changed in 2019): https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/master/eth/ethconfig/config.go#L82-L83
